functional_compartments.name: Single fiber population
functional_compartments.function_note: Forms the anterior boundary of the scalene triangle (with scalenus medius and the 1st rib) through which the brachial plexus and subclavian artery pass; the subclavian vein passes anterior to it. A classic thoracic-outlet-syndrome landmark.
functional_compartments.source: Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell); Terminologia Anatomica (FICAT 1998)
